page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture utilizing a dedicated AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at 2.7 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 4 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, alongside 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core testing placing in the top 25% at 3073.57. Multi-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU scores falling into the middle 50% tier. Cryptographic and integer operations perform adequately, supported by hardware-accelerated instruction sets such as AVX-512, AES, and SHA extensions. However, multi-threaded decompression and database operations show weaker relative performance, as evidenced by lower-tier results in multi-threaded bzip3 and PassMark database benchmarks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g8a.xlarge offers a balanced resource profile suitable for workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation without the premium cost of specialized memory or storage-optimized hardware. Given its strong single-core performance but weaker multi-threaded scaling, this instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads, lightweight web serving, application servers, and development environments that do not demand high-throughput local disk I/O or massive parallel processing.
